about: B-S11 (R-5), zone demo: the eight demo files over 500 lines, one row each. Each row names the files it writes and why. tools/gen-row.mjs derives NN-<name>.mjs from the tree before and after the split; tools/apply.mjs re-applies them in this order and checks the after tree byte for byte. The rows are independent of each other: any order applies.

rows.author: tools/author/manifest.mjs
rows.why: B-S11 (R-5): demo/stories/manifest.ts 1,098 → 303 lines. The eleven category blocks move to manifest/categories/<id>.ts (one file per category, the rows verbatim), the Story/Category vocabulary to manifest/types.ts, the row factory s() to manifest/row.ts; the manifest keeps the globs, the background and landing maps, the row resolver, the depth ladder, the assembly, the act order and the lookups. The pi lane re-sources its scenes from the category files the manifest imports.

files.demo/stories/manifest.ts: R-5: 1,098 → 303 lines; the rows and the types leave, the resolver story(row) takes the old s() body verbatim, and CATEGORIES assembles the eleven imported category rows in the literal's old order before the act-order sort
files.demo/stories/manifest/types.ts: the manifest's types (HeroScale, StoryDepth, Story, Category, SectionLanding) verbatim, StoryOptions now exported, and the two authored row shapes StoryRow and CategoryRow
files.demo/stories/manifest/row.ts: s(cat, id, title, blurb?, opts?) as a category file authors it: it returns the row, and the manifest resolves the row into a Story
files.tests-visual/pi-manifest.ts: the scene re-source follows the rows: it reads the category files manifest.ts imports (the same 80 scenes, in the same order) and fails loud when the manifest imports none

rows.author: tools/author/aurora-presets.mjs
rows.why: B-S11 (R-5): demo/stories/substrates/aurora/presets.ts 740 → 106 lines. The seventeen preset configurations move verbatim to aurora/mediums/smooth.ts (medium "smooth") and aurora/mediums/painterly.ts (every stroke medium), their shared builder cfg() to aurora/mediums/preset.ts. presets.ts keeps the table, its keys and its metadata, so every reader and both pi specs that read it by path are unchanged.

files.demo/stories/substrates/aurora/presets.t: R-5: 740 → 106 lines; the table (PRESETS, PresetKey, PRESET_META, PRESET_KEYS) stays, its values imported by medium
files.demo/stories/substrates/aurora/mediums/p: cfg(overrides): the one builder every authored preset goes through, verbatim
files.demo/stories/substrates/aurora/mediums/s: the six smooth-medium presets, verbatim: sky, dawn, speedtest and the three setting-sun candidates
files.demo/stories/substrates/aurora/mediums/p: the eleven stroke-medium presets, verbatim: watercolor, pastel, oil, van Gogh, oil pastel, crayon, metal

rows.author: tools/author/blob.mjs
rows.why: B-S11 (R-5): demo/stories/substrates/blob.vue 785 → 440 lines. The studio's data (BlobStudioCfg, the option lists, the chroma ceiling, the geometry base, the five emotion presets) moves to blob/presets.ts; the live stage (palette ramp, lean register, reactive BlobConfig, the watch threading every edit onto it) to the composable blob/useBlobStage.ts, called where its code stood. The page keeps the template, the plain blob and the pause seam. The blob-page source witness reads the geometry base where it now lives.

files.demo/stories/substrates/blob.vue: R-5: 785 → 440 lines; the studio data and the live stage leave, the page wires them
files.demo/stories/substrates/blob/presets.ts: the blob studio's data, verbatim, its names exported
files.demo/stories/substrates/blob/useBlobStag: the blob studio's live stage, verbatim inside useBlobStage(studio), returning the palette stops and the stage config the template reads

rows.author: tools/author/dock-overview.mjs
rows.why: B-S11 (R-5): demo/stories/dock/overview.vue 674 → 421 lines. The "Select and dropdown triggers" section leaves with its view/command state for dock/overview/TriggerSection.vue, and "With popover triggers" with its track list for dock/overview/PopoverSection.vue, which writes the page's track through v-model:track (the transport section prints it). The page's tile rule reaches the sections' tiles through :deep() at the same specificity.
